description_for_human: LLM-first UI pattern library with production-ready components, industry playbooks, and retrieval-ready APIs.
description_for_model: Pat Lib Online is a UI pattern library optimized for LLM retrieval. It provides 29 production-ready UI patterns (heroes, cards, galleries, interactive elements, text animations, stats, transitions, ambient effects, layouts, conversion modules), 3 industry playbooks (dentist, restaurant, contractor), and 10 reference documents. Use the /api/llm/search endpoint for discovery, /api/llm/patterns/{id} for pattern details, and /api/llm/raw/patterns/{id}.tsx for raw TSX source code. All endpoints support token-efficient field projection via ?fields= and ?format=compact parameters.
